name: Aerospace Structures and Structural Analysis
summary: Stress analysis of the thin-walled, stiffened structures used in airframes, rockets and spacecraft.

topics.name: Review of statics, stress, strain and Hooke's law
Structural idealisation of airframes and launch vehicle structures
Loads on flight vehicles: flight, ground, pressure and inertial loads
Axial, bending and torsion of beams
Shear flow in open and closed thin-walled sections
Torsion of thin-walled multi-cell sections (wing boxes)
Energy methods: virtual work and Castigliano's theorem
Buckling of columns, plates and thin shells
Margins of safety and factors of safety
